Fetch-fed player fixture

A player the page feeds itself, the way a script-driven site does: the clip is read with fetch into a blob and handed to the <video> as an object URL, so the engine never loads the clip through a media element and no request of the player carries Range. Beside it, the same clip through XMLHttpRequest, a same-origin fetch WITH a Range header (the request the phone's relay serves itself: a request observer must not report it twice), the clip from the server's other origin with and without Range (a cors-mode request carries Origin, which the relay leaves alone), one fetch through a 302, the server's JSON, and one media element whose source is a 302 to the clip (the relay's redirect hop). Per load the page records what it could see of the response on window.__player.
